notes.title: Update 2.2.0 - Steam Deck Verified ✅
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37917423/8199c0098e30bf7ef5ee4099f59d67917d65516a.jpg[/img]

Ruggnar will have a major update including the [b]Steam Deck Verification[/b] ✅!

Many improvements, additions and fixes in this [b]update 2.2.0[/b], you can find the patch notes bellow.

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Creation of new versions of the lairs.
[*] A new lair has been added and is unlocked upon finishing the game.
[*] A note now appears on the floor of the lair when the game is completed. This note allows you to move to the lair of your choice.
[*] New items available for purchase at the merchant:
[*] 3 upgrades for Fluffy.
[*] A keyring to keep your keys even after death.
[*] A wooden purse to preserve your hard-earned coins even after death.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Shields bought from the merchant now appear in the UI. You can now see if they are still available.
[*] Cinematics that have already been played will no longer play when retrying the level. However, you can still watch them in the lair.
[*] The cinematics for the encounter with the second boss can now be skipped, making retries less annoying.
[*] After defeating the first chapter’s boss for the first time, you are now redirected to the lair.
[*] The water tanks in the last encounter now have a progress bar showing the water level.
[*] The old merchant now appears on every even floor, as long as you haven’t already picked 3 modifiers.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Throwing a candle onto a coin, when in possession of the proper upgrade, now correctly collects the coin.
[*] The "25km" achievement, which could previously be missed, is now properly awarded.
[*] A system has been added to check for and unlock any missed achievements.
[*] Music should no longer stop working in a specific situation.
[*] The Discord link has been removed from the main menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Game modes
notes.content:
In Ruggnar, we've prepared you different modes to play with.

First, you will have the hand-forged [b]Story mode[/b] in which you'll follow the story of the gruff dwarf Ruggnar in his quest to make his fortune.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/0ca57928d8afd633331110a679b7c11136d81609.gif[/img]

But finishing the Story mode doesn't mean you've finished the game. You won't get rid of Ruggnar this easily! A [b]Random Dungeon mode[/b] will generate a level in which Ruggnar will have to find the key to open a coveted treasure. Will you make it to the treasure alive?

On top of that, a [b]Rogue-lite mode[/b] awaits you! Explore a 10 levels castle with increasing difficulty. No checkpoint, death is definitive here, failure is not an option. Gather gold as you might encounter your favourite merchant selling skills and upgrades. They will help him (and lower the number of gold that Ruggnar gathers) or hinder him (and increase the number of gold that Ruggnar gathers) in his quest to the reach the top of the castle. As nice as the merchant can be, he WILL retrieve what he sold you if you disappear.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/8f1941adc2550a81d5bc9e54537308558c4758e1.gif[/img]

Another mode might find its ways in Ruggnar if you finish the Story... [b]Mirror mode[/b]: every level will be inverted!

If you wish to support us, you can wishlist the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1303050/Ruggnar/

While adventuring in the deep and dangerous rooms of the castle, Ruggnar will collect precious coins. Ruggnar is somewhat of a ingenious dwarf and a fast learner but he needs help to avoid spending it all at the tavern. Help him by finding the merchant to enhance all the tools and abilities needed to ease your exploration and get even more money! From double jump to a companion helping you there is much to learn and find!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1303050/Ruggnar/

notes.title: A dangerous castle to explore
notes.content:
As he left his native mining town, Ruggnar knew it wouldn't be easy, yet exploring an abandoned castle was not dangerous enough it seems. On top of that, Ruggnar will have to brave its pitch darkness.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/134016de8d969158591ab5da0eaccc018e13fac2.gif[/img]

Fortunately, he always travels with some candles in his pocket. Light it up or activate mechanisms to make Ruggnar's life a little bit easier in this ominous castle filled with darkness. But a dwarf can only carry so much candles in his pocket, so use them wisely! So, the castle is spooky... It's covered in darkness... It's filled with traps... Did someone mentionned the traps?

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/ab58a06bc766b3847d27823a8bab12bebd395a0d.gif[/img]

Keep him clear of all the traps conveniently placed everywhere, you know, to avoid his dea.. Premature departure. Listen to the sounds of your environment, jump and crouch as Ruggnar is an agile dwarf after all.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1303050/Ruggnar/

notes.title: Ruggnar, a dwarf's story
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40469584/693d88fb9f5475355257b858261cff462c2b3afa.gif[/img]

Listening to rumors while draining his pint in a tavern, Ruggnar the gruff dwarf leaves to explore abandoned places to make a fortune. But it is without expecting the many traps protecting these treasures.

Ruggnar also stumbled upon an ever-changing castle. He swears that every time he approaches it, the castle changes, having different amounts of treasures and different placements of hazards.

You can wishlist and follow Ruggnar to get all the latest news from the tavern!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1303050/Ruggnar/
